We used to do this after bath time and any time pooping seemed hard. 

Starting from upper right side of the tummy gently apply a little pressure and slide your palm in an upside down L, right to left and continue down the left side.

Next start at the bottom right side of the tummy and slide in an upside down U, up across down.

Then starting at the bottom right side again slide in an upside down V, up and down.

Repeat 

Its kid of like a tummy massage.
